div.head: II As 6.2
div.ab: And ða blisgeras ⁊ ða ðe ðeof wræcan, beon ðæs ylca wyrþe.
Be blæserum. Ða blysieras ond þa ðe ðeof wrecen, beon þæs ilcan ryhtes wyrðe.
And þa blisgeras ⁊ þa þe þeof wrecan, beon þæs ylca wyrð.
Et blasigeras et qui furem uindicauerint, sint eiusdem digni.
Be blæserum. Ða blysieras ond þa ðe ðeof wrecen, beon þæs ilcan ryhtes wyrðe.
Incendiaries, and those who avenge a thief, shall be subject to the same law.
Von Brandstiftern. Die Brandstifter und die, welche einen [hingerichteten] Dieb rächen, seien desselben Strafrechtes theilhaftig.
Of arsonists. The arsonists and those who avenge a [executed] thief are to be subject to the same penal law.
div.note: Ld has the marginal gloss ‘al[ias] beligeras, quod sonat: accusatores falsos’. The heading is H's.
